name: Message Logger
author: Colgram
description: Saves every incoming and outgoing message to a local JSONL file in the Colgram sandbox, including edits and deletions.

name: Auto Reply
author: Colgram
description: Replies to incoming private messages with a configurable canned response while you are marked offline.

name: Chat Exporter
author: Colgram
description: Exports the current chat history to HTML with media links intact, ready to open in any browser.

name: Keyword Alerts
author: Colgram
description: Watches every chat for a list of keywords and raises a local notification when one appears.
